description: Run a LegalPass issue-spotting pass against a URL, contract upload, or repo. With fixture_text, returns deterministic public evidence; without it, returns the guarded run plan.

fixture_text.description: Public text to check deterministically for dogfood or local proof

branch.description: Optional branch name for repo runs

commit.description: Optional commit SHA for repo runs

target_sha.description: Optional commit or target evidence SHA to bind the LegalPass receipt to a specific target version

target_url.description: URL target shortcut for TestPass-style callers

name: legalpass_run
